transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Since the annual shareholder meeting is six weeks out, I'd like to get us aligned on the proxy statement timeline. We have three shareholder matters, the executive compensation section, and a proposed charter amendment in the draft. Under our ordinary filing timetable, legal review needs to be completed before we submit to the regulator, and the pre-filing checklist requires sign-off from securities, executive-compensation, and corporate-records counsel on any changes before that review wraps up. Can I get a status update from each of you on where things stand?
